items.source: Set the order for the SimpUserRegistry to use as a SmartApplicationListener.
items.translation: 将 `SimpUserRegistry` 的顺序设置为用作 `SmartApplicationListener`。

items.source: By default AntPathMatcher is configured. However applications may provide an AntPathMatcher instance customized to use "." (commonly used in messaging) instead of "/" as path separator or provide a completely different PathMatcher implementation.
items.translation: 默认情况下，配置了AntPathMatcher。然而，应用程序可以提供自定义的AntPathMatcher实例，以使用"."（在消息传递中常用）而不是"/"作为路径分隔符，或者提供完全不同的 PathMatcher 实现。

items.source:
When messages are processed, the matching prefix is removed from the destination
in order to form the lookup path. This means annotations should not contain the
destination prefix.
items.translation: 处理消息时，会从目标中移除匹配的前缀以形成查找路径。这意味着注解不应包含目标前缀。

items.source: Prefixes that do not have a trailing slash will have one automatically appended.
items.translation: 不带尾随斜杠的前缀将自动附加一个。

items.source:
For example when a user attempts to subscribe to "/user/queue/position-updates",
the destination may be translated to "/queue/position-updates-useri9oqdfzo" yielding a
unique queue name that does not collide with any other user attempting to do the same.
Subsequently when messages are sent to "/user/{username}/queue/position-updates",
the destination is translated to "/queue/position-updates-useri9oqdfzo".
items.translation: 例如，当用户尝试订阅"/user/queue/position-updates"时，目标可能会被转换为"/queue/position-updates-useri9oqdfzo"，从而生成一个与其他执行相同操作的用户不冲突的唯一队列名称。随后，当消息被发送到"/user/{username}/queue/position-updates"时，目标会被转换为"/queue/position-updates-useri9oqdfzo"。

items.source: The default prefix used to identify such destinations is "/user/".
items.translation: 用于标识此类目标的默认前缀是"/user/"。

items.source:
Note that the configured PathMatcher is only used for matching the
portion of the destination after the configured prefix. For example given
application destination prefix "/app" and destination "/app/price.stock.**",
the message might be mapped to a controller with "price" and "stock.**"
as its type and method-level mappings respectively.
items.translation: 请注意，配置的 PathMatcher 仅用于匹配配置前缀之后的部分。例如，给定应用程序目的地前缀 "/app" 和目的地 "/app/price.stock.**"，消息可能会被映射到具有 "price" 和 "stock.**" 作为其类型和方法级映射的控制器。

items.source:
When the simple broker is enabled, the PathMatcher configured here is
also used to match message destinations when brokering messages.
items.translation: 启用简单代理时，此处配置的 PathMatcher 也用于在代理消息时匹配消息目的地。

items.source:
This is currently only applied for the destination cache in the
subscription registry. The default cache limit there is 1024.
items.translation: 这目前仅适用于订阅注册表中的目标缓存。该处的默认缓存限制为 1024。

items.source:
Enable a simple message broker and configure one or more prefixes to filter
destinations targeting the broker (for example, destinations prefixed with "/topic").
items.translation: 启用简单的消息代理，并配置一个或多个前缀以筛选针对该代理的目标（例如，以前缀"/topic"开头的目标）。

items.source:
Enable a STOMP broker relay and configure the destination prefixes supported by the
message broker. Check the STOMP documentation of the message broker for supported
destinations.
items.translation: 启用 STOMP 代理中继并配置消息代理支持的目的地前缀。请查阅消息代理的 STOMP 文档以获取支持的目的地信息。

items.source:
Customize the channel used to send messages from the application to the message
broker. By default, messages from the application to the message broker are sent
synchronously, which means application code sending a message will find out
if the message cannot be sent through an exception. However, this can be changed
if the broker channel is configured here with task executor properties.
items.translation: 自定义应用程序向消息代理发送消息所使用的通道。默认情况下，从应用程序到消息代理的消息是同步发送的，这意味着发送消息的应用程序代码可以通过异常得知消息是否无法发送。但是，如果在此处使用任务执行器属性配置了代理通道，则可以更改此行为。

items.source: order - the order value
items.translation: order - 订单值

items.source: When this flag is set to true messages within the same session will be sent to the "clientOutboundChannel" one at a time in order to preserve the order of publication.
items.translation: 当此标志设置为 `true` 时，同一会话中的消息将按顺序逐个发送到 `"clientOutboundChannel"`，以保持发布顺序。

items.source: By default messages sent to the "clientOutboundChannel" may not be processed in the same order because the channel is backed by a ThreadPoolExecutor that in turn does not guarantee processing in order.
items.translation: 默认情况下，发送到 `"clientOutboundChannel"` 的消息可能不会按顺序处理，因为该通道由 `ThreadPoolExecutor` 支持，而后者无法保证按顺序处理。

items.source: Configure the PathMatcher to use to match the destinations of incoming messages to @MessageMapping and @SubscribeMapping methods.
items.translation: 配置用于匹配传入消息的目的地到 `@MessageMapping` 和 `@SubscribeMapping` 方法的 PathMatcher。

items.source: A registry for configuring message broker options.
items.translation: 用于配置消息代理选项的注册表。

items.source:
Customize the channel used to send messages from the application to the message
broker.
items.translation: 自定义应用程序向消息代理发送消息所使用的通道。

items.source:
Enable a STOMP broker relay and configure the destination prefixes supported by the
message broker.
items.translation: 启用 STOMP 代理中继并配置消息代理支持的目的地前缀。

items.source:
Configure one or more prefixes to filter destinations targeting application
annotated methods.
items.translation: 配置一个或多个前缀，以筛选针对应用注解方法的目的地。

items.source: Configure the cache limit to apply for registrations with the broker.
items.translation: 配置缓存限制以适用于与代理的注册。

items.source: Whether the client must receive messages in the order of publication.
items.translation: 客户端是否必须按发布顺序接收消息。

items.source: Configure the prefix used to identify user destinations.
items.translation: 配置用于标识用户目标的名称前缀。
